name: Expense Report
description: An employee's expense claim: receipts grouped into a report that is submitted, approved and reimbursed.

global.schema:
type ExpenseReportState {
  title: String
  submitter: Person!
  status: ExpenseStatus!
  currency: String!
  items: [ExpenseItem!]!
  submittedAt: DateTime
  decidedAt: DateTime
  decidedBy: String
  decisionNote: String
  reimbursedAt: DateTime
  reimbursementTransactionId: String
}

type Person {
  name: String
  email: String
}

type ExpenseItem {
  id: OID!
  spentAt: DateTime!
  merchant: String!
  category: TransactionCategory!
  amount: Float!
  vatAmount: Float!
  paidWith: PaidWith!
  receiptName: String
  note: String
  contactId: String
}

enum ExpenseStatus {
  DRAFT
  SUBMITTED
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
  REIMBURSED
}

enum PaidWith {
  COMPANY_CARD
  PERSONAL
  CASH
}

enum TransactionCategory {
  UNCATEGORIZED
  SALES
  SUPPLIES
  PAYROLL
  RENT
  SOFTWARE
  TRAVEL
  MARKETING
  TAX
  BANK_FEES
  TRANSFER
  OTHER
}
global.initialValue: {"title": null, "submitter": {"name": null, "email": null}, "status": "DRAFT", "currency": "EUR", "items": [], "submittedAt": null, "decidedAt": null, "decidedBy": null, "decisionNote": null, "reimbursedAt": null, "reimbursementTransactionId": null}
